bounds.domain: One supervisor and one agent child launched alone, with no gateway or broker. Start, restart and stop in any state; the pre-spawn refusals config, payload, storage and credential; a spawn that fails, classified as agent on the device and in development; a failure the supervisor cannot classify, named runtime; readiness, timeout and child exit before readiness; child exit while running, restarted within a budget of two.
bounds.assumptions: Readiness is an observed authenticated probe of the agent's own endpoint. A refused check or a failed spawn leaves no child. Stop, restart, timeout and failure request the child's destruction, modeled as immediate; physical exit is outside this model and in ParallelRuntimeStartup.
bounds.progress: A spawned agent's readiness wait ends (running, failed, stopped or a new launch) under weak fairness of advance, which includes the readiness deadline. Without fairness the wait may stutter forever. A host that restarts forever keeps a start from settling; that is not excluded.
bounds.limitations: Elapsed time, the back-off delay, the Android foreground-service rules, the route allowlist and the stream bridge are outside the model. The device service and plugin have never run on a device or emulator; the development launch and the JVM supervisor are checked by the conformance contracts.

assumptions: Weak fairness of advance: readiness, its deadline and exit observation. No assumption that the agent becomes ready. A host may restart or stop a wait; that also ends it.
No fairness. A readiness wait may stutter forever.
